title: Paul McCartney live: Arena MRV, Belo Horizonte | 2023
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Arena MRV in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, on 4 December 2023.

It was the 31st show of the Got Back Tour, which lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025, and the second of two consecutive nights in Belo Horizonte.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
